verdict.rationale: The docs say an agent is configured with instructions and tools from a small set of primitives. Any Python function can become a tool, with automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation, which delivers typed custom tools. A community user independently reports it is much simpler to use than LangChain. missing for 10: a concrete code snippet showing the few-lines claim, and independent hands-on corroboration of the typed schema and validation behavior specifically.
